items_flat.title_en: Grok Bot gains its own email addresses for signups, outreach and scheduling
items_flat.title_zh: Grok Bot 獲得專屬電子郵件，可用於註冊、聯絡與排程
items_flat.summary_en: xAI’s official @bot account announced on October 9 that Grok Bot now has its own email inbox on the @mail.grokbot.com domain. Users claim an address by asking their Bot or tagging @bot on X; the agent can then sign up for services, contact businesses, or schedule time with people. Team plans require admin enablement first. The feature is rolling out now.
items_flat.summary_zh: xAI 官方 @bot 帳號於 10 月 9 日宣布，Grok Bot 現已擁有 @mail.grokbot.com 網域的專屬信箱。使用者可請 Bot 或在 X 上標註 @bot 來申請地址；代理可用它註冊服務、聯絡企業或與人排程。團隊方案需管理員先開啟。功能正在逐步推出。
items_flat.analysis_en: Giving persistent agents their own identity for external interactions lowers friction for real-world tasks such as account creation or vendor outreach. Key uncertainty remains around retention limits, approval flows before sending, and how uniquely claimed addresses interact with enterprise controls.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 讓持續運作的代理擁有外部互動身份，可降低帳號建立或供應商聯絡等真實世界任務的摩擦。關鍵不確定性在於保留期限、發送前核准流程，以及唯一地址與企業管控的互動方式。
items_flat.quote: Grok Bot now has its own email. Bot can use it to sign up for services, contact businesses for you, or schedule time with someone.
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok Bot 現在擁有自己的電子郵件。Bot 可以用它為你註冊服務、聯絡企業，或與人排程。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic adds dynamic workflows to Claude Managed Agents in public beta
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 為 Claude Managed Agents 加入公開 beta 動態工作流程
items_flat.summary_en: On October 9 Anthropic launched dynamic workflows for Claude Managed Agents in public beta. A lead agent can write a workflow—a program that runs many agents in phases and combines results—executed on Anthropic’s servers in the background. A single run can launch up to 1,000 agents over its lifetime (64 concurrent). In an internal test with 70 planted bugs in a 116k-line codebase, a single agent found 14–27 bugs per run while the workflow consistently found 66.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 於 10 月 9 日為 Claude Managed Agents 推出公開 beta 動態工作流程。主代理可撰寫工作流程（分階段執行多個代理並彙整結果的程式），由 Anthropic 伺服器在背景執行。單次執行生命週期內最多可啟動 1000 個代理（同時 64 個）。在含 70 個植入漏洞的 11.6 萬行程式碼庫測試中，單一代理每輪找到 14–27 個，工作流程則穩定找到 66 個。
items_flat.analysis_en: Server-side multi-agent orchestration at this scale makes large decomposition tasks (code audits, document review) more practical without local harness management. The token cost of 1,000-agent runs remains the central uncertainty; Anthropic’s own bug-finding delta is striking but still needs independent confirmation across other workload types.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此規模的伺服器端多代理協調，讓大型拆解任務（程式碼稽核、文件審查）無需本地 harness 管理即可更實用。1000 個代理執行的 token 成本仍是核心不確定性；Anthropic 自身的漏洞發現差距令人注目，但仍需在其他工作負載類型上獲得獨立驗證。
items_flat.quote: Claude Managed Agents dynamic workflows are now available in public beta. It's a new type of multiagent orchestration, built for your most ambitious workloads. A lead agent writes a plan that runs across many agents in phases, combining the results at the end.
items_flat.quote_zh: Claude Managed Agents 動態工作流程現已公開 beta。這是一種新型多代理協調，專為最雄心勃勃的工作負載打造。主代理撰寫計畫，分階段在多個代理上執行，最後彙整結果。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches beta composer predictions in Codex for Pro users
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 為 Pro 用戶在 Codex 推出 beta 版作曲家預測
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI added composer predictions in beta to the Codex desktop app on October 9. After Codex responds, it can suggest a complete next message based on the current thread and the user’s style. Available to personal ChatGPT Pro users (18+) in local and SSH threads with GPT-6 Astra or GPT-6.1 Sol. Generating predictions costs nothing extra and does not count toward usage limits during the beta; users press Tab to accept, then review and send.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 於 10 月 9 日在 Codex 桌面應用程式加入 beta 版作曲家預測。Codex 回覆後，可根據當前對話與使用者風格建議完整下一則訊息。僅限個人 ChatGPT Pro 用戶（18 歲以上）在本地或 SSH 執行緒中使用 GPT-6 Astra 或 GPT-6.1 Sol。Beta 期間產生預測不額外收費也不計入用量上限；使用者按 Tab 接受後再檢視並發送。
items_flat.analysis_en: Autocomplete on the human side of the agent loop reduces repetitive prompting in coding sessions. Because it remains Pro-only and desktop-app limited, broader impact depends on whether OpenAI expands eligibility and how well predictions avoid reinforcing user biases already present in the thread.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 在代理循環的人類端加入自動完成，可減少編碼會話中的重複提示。因目前僅限 Pro 與桌面應用，實際影響取決於 OpenAI 是否擴大資格，以及預測能否避免強化執行緒中已有的使用者偏見。
items_flat.quote: Now in beta: composer predictions in Codex for Pro users. Codex can now suggest your next message based on your conversation and how you talk to it. One of the most loved new features we've ever tested internally.
items_flat.quote_zh: 現已進入 beta：Codex 為 Pro 用戶提供作曲家預測。Codex 現在可根據你的對話與說話方式建議下一則訊息。這是我們內部測試過最受喜愛的新功能之一。

brief_zh: 今日開局平靜，主要延續10月9日動態：xAI 讓 Grok Bot 擁有 @mail.grokbot.com 專屬信箱用於註冊與排程，OpenAI 為 Pro 用戶推出 Codex 作曲家預測 beta，Anthropic 則為 Claude Managed Agents 加入動態工作流程，單次可協調最多 1000 個代理。
